policy_summary: May 2026: plans announced for six new short-stay motorhome parking sites, intended to consolidate parking and reduce wild camping in residential areas. Restrictions focused on Marine Drive in Rhyl where motorhomes previously parked freely. Short-stay bays proposed in Ruthin, Corwen and Llangollen. Provision-and-restriction together, same pattern as Northumberland.
open_questions: Are the six sites live yet, or still proposed? Announced May 2026.
Which six, and at what price?
What instrument covers the Marine Drive restriction?

sites.name: Marine Drive, Rhyl
sites.notes: Previously free overnight motorhome parking; restricted as of the May 2026 announcement.

sites.name: Short-stay motorhome bays, Ruthin / Corwen / Llangollen
